notes.title: Lotus: Lost Memories launches August 1st for $4.99 USD
notes.notes: [h1]The full game is almost here.[/h1][p][/p][p]If you played the demo, you’ve seen Chapter 1 and a portion of Chapter 2. The full release completes the rest of Chapter 2 and delivers the entire Chapter 3. New [b]characters[/b], new [b]locations[/b], and the long-awaited [b]tournament[/b] arc.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/bc771f68f9855bb88290a937d5d5b5c9f2c59654.png"][/img][/p][p]Expect around [b]3 hours[/b] of story-rich gameplay, culminating in a [b]cinematic finale[/b] that brings Atsushi’s journey to a close… [i]for now.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/1ac3b3d0dc3974e31b800fe97f5d71700b6ee53e.png"][/img][/p][p]Once the story ends, [i]Gauntlet Mode[/i] begins. A pure combat challenge set in the tournament arena featuring an online [b]leaderboard[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1]August 1st. Steam. $4.99. 5pm EST[/h1]

notes.title: Our Demo is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Lotus: Lost Memories will be playable during Steam Next Fest! This is your chance to dive into the world we’ve been building, experience the atmosphere, and give us your feedback.

Immerse yourself, fight, and uncover the beginning of the story before the full release. The demo will be available throughout Steam Next Fest and after! Mark your calendars and get ready!

Stay tuned for the exact release time. We can’t wait to hear what you think!
